items.description: Chaque jour, des millions d’Éthiopiens s’informent sur les réseaux sociaux. items.title: Latest Terrestrial Energy topical report submission could lead to faster deployment
items.summary: Approval of the Thermal and Electric Facility Topical Report submitted by the company to US regulators would mean that part of the Integrated Molten Salt Reactor plant would be classed as a conventional industrial, rather than nuclear, project, allowing it to be built and operated ahead of nuclear licensing.

items.title: Legislative amendment paves way for continued operation of Borssele
items.summary: As the Dutch Senate approves an amendment to the Nuclear Energy Act, allowing a possible life extension of the Borssele nuclear power plant beyond 2033, the government said it has reached an agreement on acquiring 70% of the shares of operator EPZ.

items.title: Four key issues when building nuclear in different countries, according to Rosatom

items.title: Timeline for Polish nuclear units slips in updated programme
